## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (`pnpm test`)
- [ ] New or changed tools follow "Adding a tool safely" in the README (side effects => `sideEffects: true`)
- [ ] Eval dataset/recordings updated if agent behaviour changed (`EVAL_RECORD=1 pnpm eval`, diff reviewed)
- [ ] No secrets, real customer data or unscrubbed model output in the diff
